items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: in the floor shows, all those years in the blue room with Kellner... I know I went to some shows with him over there.

ctx.x: Buttsy wasn't the greatest drummer in the world, but he was a gentleman.

Yeah, that's, yeah, that's right. He was a gentleman. He was a gentleman. And, uh, well, in the floor shows, all those years in the blue room with Kellner, he couldn't cut the mustard there, according to Kellner. Kellner wasn't the greatest conductor in the world. Well, neither. No. Every time he got hard on the piano, he got out and conducted. He couldn't play it, he'd get out there and conduct. I know I went to some shows with him over there. So, uh,
I understand Kellner's not over there. No, he's gone. He's down in Florida somewhere.
